text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm surely... lacking so much... 
Confidence... talent... everything.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, no matter how much time 
passes, I'll never become an Umamusume who 
can stand tall and proud...
choice_data_list:
You've gotta use that frustration as a 
springboard.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Why... can you say that to me...? To 
someone like me, who just keeps on 
losing...
choice_data_list: It stings to lose because you have pride.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
choice_data_list: It's still deep in your heart, isn't it?

It's still in the back of your mind, isn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...... You always believe in me, 
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I have to keep running... I'll run, 
Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Channeling that frustration as a 
springboard...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Then, since I'm feeling so terribly 
frustrated... from here on... will I reach 
crazy new heights...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...That's true. There's nothing else to do 
but believe that...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Would you like to brainstorm together? 
About our strategy for the next race."
